# GeneratorInstallerList.com

> GeneratorInstallerList is a buyer-first directory of standby generator installers across 50 US states. We filter the noise across electricians, HVAC shops, and generator companies so buyers can find someone who has actually installed a whole-home generator before, for any brand. Listings are sorted by website signal: dedicated generator page, repeated mentions, or at least one clear mention worth a first call. Independent. Not a broker. Not an endorsement.

## Coverage

- Full interactive directory for all 50 states at /installers/{state-slug}.
- Unique state market notes cover heating-fuel mix (ACS 2024), 2024 outage duration (EIA), NEC edition notes, and licensing hooks from internal research.
- ZIP near-me search, metro pages, brand tag pages, and installer profiles are live nationally.
- Installer profile copy was generated with Gemini 3.6 Flash from website signal and generator-filtered reviews.

## Primary entry points

- [Home](https://www.generatorinstallerlist.com/): national overview and method
- [Installers by state](https://www.generatorinstallerlist.com/installers): 50-state index
- [Generator installation near me](https://www.generatorinstallerlist.com/installers/near-me): ZIP search against listing coordinates
- [Buyer guides](https://www.generatorinstallerlist.com/guides): cost, sizing, process, fuel, permits, hiring
- [Financing](https://www.generatorinstallerlist.com/financing): how standby projects are often financed; deferred-interest trap guidance
- [About](https://www.generatorinstallerlist.com/about): how the research works
- [For installers](https://www.generatorinstallerlist.com/for-installers): corrections, additions, removals
- [Contact](https://www.generatorinstallerlist.com/contact): buyer and installer questions
- [Privacy](https://www.generatorinstallerlist.com/privacy): analytics and data practices

Brand filters are convenience views. The directory is brand-agnostic.

## Metro pages

Metro pages live at /installers/{state-slug}/metros/{metro-slug}. Full enumeration is in the sitemap (/sitemap.xml).

## What this site is not

- Not a lead-generation broker.
- Not affiliated with any generator manufacturer.
- Not selling installer rank.
- Listings are not endorsements. They are better starting points for the buyer's own due diligence on licensing, insurance, references, and scope.
- We do not publish fabricated state-by-state average installation cost tables.
